summary: A paged product tour in a dialog, one step at a time, with a count or a progress bar.

props.name: triggerIcon
props.description: A glyph beside the trigger's label.

props.name: iconPosition
props.description: Which end of the trigger its `triggerIcon` sits at.

props.name: steps

example.title: Welcome
example.description: A short tour of what you can do here, three screens long.

example.title: Build your first page
example.description: Drop in a component, adjust its props, and watch it update. Everything on the page is a real control, so what you see is what the snippet says.

tasks.label: Drop a component onto the page

example.title: Keep it somewhere
example.description: Pick the folder your files live in. You can move it later.

props.description: Each step's `icon`, `title` and `description`. Steps advance one at a time and the dialog resets to the first when it closes.

props.name: indicator
props.description: `count` reads "1 / 3" in the header. `progress` draws a filling bar under the slide. `dots` moves navigation to a bottom row of step dots between prev/next arrows. `checklist` counts the current step's `tasks` instead of the steps, and falls back to the step count on a step with none.

props.name: showClose
props.description: An X in the corner, so the tour can be skipped without walking to the end.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius on the trigger, the popup and its controls.

props.name: animated
props.description: The slide transition between steps and the popup's scale-in. Turn it off for an instant tour, or when the user has asked for reduced motion.

props.name: animatedResize
props.description: The popup's grow and shrink as steps of different heights come and go. Only steps with `tasks` change height, so this does nothing without them.

props.name: container
props.description: Where the popup is rendered. Defaults to `document.body`, which is right almost always; pass an element to portal somewhere else, such as inside a frame or a container that owns its own stacking context.
